title: Sausage and fennel
preamble:
8 pork sausages

1 onion - thickly sliced

3 cloves garlic - minced

6 tomatoes - chopped

1/2 fennel bulb
ingredients: 1 glass of red or white wine
method: Pre-heat the oven to Gas Mark 5.
Fry onions until soft, add garlic, carrot, tomato puree and fennel and fry for a couple of minutes.
Add a glass of white or red wine and let it simmer for a couple of minutes.
Add stock, beans and sweet pepper. Add back the sausages.
Bring to simmer then put in oven for 45 minutes.
